checks.name: Four actual mirror contours render fresh host-scene pixels and survive separate browser restarts

Side-wall mirror uses the same real plane and reflected host scene
Hidden mirrors stop passes; building and two-floor views release targets without changing stored facts
One host frame admits one reflection and multiple mirrors do not recursively allocate targets
A real nested-render exception rejects the candidate, rebuilds the renderer and preserves document/save
A broken real mirror shader is rejected before replacing the current scene or saved bytes
Actual WebGL canvas and bound-target scissor states survive the reflection prepass exactly
Four actual looks reflect and recover exact nondefault lamp state after separate browser shutdowns
Three folded planes render independent current pixels with moving real geometry behind the main camera
Actual warm local light illuminates a nonemissive receiver, with measurable off/half/full output and lamp UI state
Repeated swaps and lightweight building view release all mirror targets, preserving saved lamp state
Second room uses its real rotated parent plane and keeps independent state through close and restore
A real shader failure on the second candidate panel rejects the entire group while keeping old geometry and saved bytes
All standalone manifest bytes match before editing
Standalone edit changes one mirror and one lamp state; unpaired movement is rejected without a partial output
Imported independent two-room scene loads actual models, preserves child state and requests only package resources
Complete edited company survives a separate browser process and both room views

evidence.scope: CPU deterministic production and actual GLTFLoader / independent geometry readback of four tabletop makeup mirrors

conclusion: Existing wall mirrors prove wall reflection with empty device state; tabletop makeup mirrors prove one/three planes and light output on vanity top. No actual catalog resource or identified evidence combines the confirmed wall makeup installation, bounded panels and local light contract.
